## Handover notes

- `a10-security--dep-request`: `shared_handover_write` to the requesting agent (A05, A06 or A14, from step 1) with `goal` (decision on the package), `completed` (checks run), `remaining` (conditions to satisfy), `decisions` (verdict and the check that decided it), `constraints` (conditions), `open_questions` (missing limits or feeds), and `verification` {status `verified` when all four checks ran, else `partial`; checks `sec_dependency_age:stale=<bool>`, `sec_kev_match_count:<n>`}.
- `a10-security--iac-review`: `shared_handover_write` to A11 with `goal` (fix the listed infrastructure findings), `completed` (rule families and files reviewed), `remaining` (fixes per finding id), `decisions` (severity choices and any score used), `constraints` (no production scanning), `blockers` (blocking finding ids), `artifacts` (kind `gate.verdict`, the verdict path, digest from step 8, producer A10), and `verification` {status `verified` or `partial`; checks `swarm_gate:iac`, `sec_tls_min_version`, `sec_header_presence`, `shared_verdict`}.
- `a10-security--incident-evidence`: `shared_handover_write` to A13 (bundle) with `goal` (evidence for the incident), `completed` (files collected and screened), `remaining` (items not obtainable), `decisions` (what was redacted and why), `artifacts` ({kind, uri, digest, producer} for every file, producer being its author), `open_questions` (missing logs or time windows), `constraints` (redacted copies only, no credential values), and `verification` {status `partial` while any excerpt stayed unscanned, else `verified`; checks `sec_credential_scan:findings=<n>`}.
- `a10-security--migration-review`: `shared_handover_write` to A07 with `goal` (resolve the migration findings), `completed` (files and lines reviewed), `remaining` (fixes), `decisions` (severity rationale), `open_questions` (columns needing PII classification), `blockers` (blocking finding ids), `artifacts` (kind `gate.verdict`, the verdict path, digest from step 9, producer A10), and `verification` {status `verified` or `partial`; checks `sec_credential_scan:findings=<n>`, `grep:grants`, `shared_verdict:<verdict>`}.
- `a10-security--pr-gate`: Call `shared_handover_write` with `to_agent` A01, `goal` (gate verdict for the patch), `completed` (scans run, with `runs` states), `remaining` (fixes owed by A05/A06), `decisions` (cross-check outcome), `artifacts` (kind `gate.verdict`, uri the verdict path, digest from step 6, producer A10), `open_questions` (gaps from steps 1 and 4), `blockers` (blocking finding ids), and `verification` {status `verified` when no `runs` entry is skipped, else `partial`; confidence; checks such as `swarm_gate:fail`, `shared_verdict:fail`}.
- `a10-security--release-strict`: `shared_handover_write` to A12 with `goal` (fresh security verdict for the candidate), `completed` (strict checks, freshness, KEV), `remaining` (manual DAST window or fresh KEV fetch if open), `decisions` (cache vs live feed, DAST outcome), `artifacts` (kind `gate.verdict`, uri `.swarm/verdicts/<gate task_id>.security.json`, digest, producer A10), `blockers` (finding ids, `verdict expired`), `constraints` (valid until issue time + 24 h), and `verification` {status `verified` only when every scanner ran and the freshness check passed, else `partial`; checks `strict:emulated`, `rel_gate_freshness:ok=<bool>`}.
- `a10-security--risk-exception`: `shared_handover_write` to A01 for medium items (for high items too, naming the human decision as `remaining`; the `owner` returned by `shared_escalate`, A01 or A14, is who tracks it) with `goal` (decide on the listed exceptions), `completed` (checks run), `remaining` (approval or human decision), `decisions` (path chosen and band), `constraints` (expiry required, no self-approval), `blockers` (items awaiting L4), and `verification` {status `verified`; checks `sec_allowlist_check:valid=<bool>`, `sec_cvss_band:<band>`}.
- `a10-security--sbom-attest`: `shared_handover_write` to A12 with `goal` (SBOM attestation for the release), `completed` (summary, diff, KEV checks), `remaining` (fixes when refused), `decisions` (attested or refused with reason), `artifacts` (kind `sbom.attestation` or `sbom`, uri the SBOM path, digest from step 2, producer A11 for the SBOM), `blockers` (unpinned names, KEV ids), and `verification` {status `verified` or `partial`; checks `sec_sbom_summary:all_pinned=<bool>`, `sec_sbom_diff:drift=<bool>`}.
- `a10-security--scanner-conflict`: `shared_handover_write` to A01 (advisory) with `goal` (record the merged findings), `completed` (groups merged, conflicts logged), `decisions` (final severity per conflict with the tool that set it), `artifacts` (none unless a report file is saved, then kind `security.findings` with digest), `open_questions` (a scanner whose rating you could not reproduce), and `verification` {status `verified`; checks `sec_finding_dedup:groups=<n>`, `shared_verdict:<verdict>`}.
- `a10-security--secret-triage`: `shared_handover_write` to A05 (fix task) with `goal` (remove or rotate the listed secrets), `completed` (hits classified), `remaining` (rotation, removal, re-scan), `decisions` (classification with rationale per id), `artifacts` (none unless a report file exists in the workspace, then kind `security.findings` with its digest), `constraints` (no values in commits, history rewrite needs a human), `blockers` (ids classified `real`), and `verification` {status `partial` when any hit stayed unresolved, else `verified`; checks `sec_credential_scan:rules`, `sec_line_entropy:<figure>`}.
- `a10-security--threat-review`: `shared_handover_write` to A03 (gaps) with `goal` (close the listed design gaps), `completed` (threats reviewed), `remaining` (uncovered and partial threats), `decisions` (accepted controls with rationale), `open_questions` (answers needed from A03), `blockers` (high-impact uncovered threats), `artifacts` (kind `security.findings` if a report file was kept, with digest), and `verification` {status `partial` when any artifact was unchecked, else `verified`; checks `shared_artifact_check`, `sec_tls_min_version`, `sec_header_presence`}. Copy A01 on the task result when blockers exist.
- `a10-security--vuln-flood`: `shared_handover_write` to A14 (patch plan) with `goal` (remediate the flood advisory), `completed` (grouping and scoring), `remaining` (the ordered remediation list), `decisions` (severity and deadline per group), `constraints` (the 24 h and 72 h targets, KEV first), `open_questions` (affected components that could not be resolved), `artifacts` (kind `vulnerability.report`, uri, digest, producer A10), and `verification` {status `verified` or `partial` when the feed was a cache; checks `sec_finding_dedup:group_count`, `sec_kev_match_count:matched_count`}.
